title: Bijectivity of a generalized Pak-Stanley labeling
summary: The Pak-Stanley labeling is a bijection between the regions of the $m$-Shi arrangement and the $m$-parking functions. Mazin generalized this labeling to every deformation of the braid arrangement and proved that this labeling is always surjective onto a set of directed multigraph parking functions. We provide a right inverse to the generalized Pak-Stanley labeling, and identify a class $\mathcal{C}$ of arrangements for which this labeling is bijective.
